verdict.rationale: Airweave exposes a full REST API (OpenAPI spec), a self-hosted deployment path (docker/start.sh), a terminal CLI, and webhooks for event-driven automation — all of which support headless/programmatic use outside a UI, which is the core requirement for CI automation. However there is no explicit CI/CD example, GitHub Actions integration, or documented non-interactive auth flow (e.g., API-key-only headless setup) confirming CI-specific usage. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, documented non-interactive authentication for automated environments, and independent confirmation of headless operation in production automation.
